title: Purchase / Receipt Document
description: The document trail for parts ordered from PACCAR or another vendor arriving at the dealership and being checked into inventory.
x-sap-analogue: Purchase order + goods receipt (EKKO/EKBE) feeding a three-way match against the vendor invoice
x-api-note: No public spec names vendor-invoice or purchase-order matching; only a General Ledger Inquiry API supporting search/view of GL transaction history is confirmed, plus indirect competitor evidence (Karmak) that PO receipts 'can be automatically posted into Accounts Payable.'
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.

receipt_against_po_transaction_code_norm.description: CDK's transaction code sheet confirms a normal receipt posts an on-hand increase against a purchase order
receipt_against_po_transaction_code_norm.x-cdk-field-name: Receipt against PO (transaction code, normal receipt)
receipt_against_po_transaction_code_norm.x-source-title: Total Dealer Solutions — CDK Transaction Codes

edi_856_asn_advance_ship_notice.description: PACCAR's order flow confirms Order to Receipt happens via ePortal/EDI 856 Advance Ship Notice
edi_856_asn_advance_ship_notice.x-source-title: EDIXT PACCAR Parts EDI spec page

return_to_vendor_transaction_code.description: CDK's transaction code for returning parts to the vendor, part of 'dirty core' processing and RDCI reconciliation

physical_inventory_adjustment_codes_m_mi.description: CDK codes M (minus adjustment) and P (plus adjustment) for correcting on-hand quantity after a physical count
physical_inventory_adjustment_codes_m_mi.x-cdk-field-name: Physical inventory adjustment codes (M = minus, P = plus)
physical_inventory_adjustment_codes_m_mi.x-source-title: Total Dealer Solutions — CDK Transaction Codes

three_way_match_po_receipt_vendor_invoic.description: Standard accounting practice; competitor DMS Karmak explicitly documents PO receipts posting automatically into AP, implying a similar capability exists in the CDK/PACCAR chain

general_ledger_inquiry_api_gl_transactio.description: A separate API supporting search/view of GL transaction history, the closest confirmed link between receiving and the ledger
general_ledger_inquiry_api_gl_transactio.x-cdk-field-name: General Ledger Inquiry API (GL transaction history)
